purpose: Evidence-gated classification of four high-coverage Germany CPO prefixes from the certified 568-prefix audit. Aggregators are discovery/support evidence only; no sampled tariff is generalized.

DEONE.operator: reev platform prefix / multiple physical operators
DEONE.finding: reev officially documents DE*ONE*EXXXX as the EVSE-ID format assigned by its platform. The certified Germany audit shows many distinct physical operators under DEONE, so DEONE is a technical/shared platform prefix rather than a single tariff authority.
DEONE.neededToComplete: Resolve each DEONE EVSE to its physical CPO and exact public ad-hoc/app tariff shown after EVSE/QR selection. Never apply a DEONE-wide tariff.

DEISE.operator: shared Compleo/legacy platform prefix / multiple physical operators
DEISE.finding: The certified audit contains many physical operators under DEISE (including enviaM, LEW Natur, Ladestationen Südwest and ENNI). Public station evidence confirms DE*ISE EVSEs assigned to different operators, and sampled exact station tariffs vary; therefore no prefix-wide tariff is defensible.
DEISE.neededToComplete: Resolve each DEISE EVSE to the physical operator and obtain exact station/EVSE direct pricing from operator checkout, Mobilithek/AFIR/DATEX II or another verifiable station-level source. Aggregator prices remain discovery-only.

DEEZE.finding: eze.network's official public charging page publishes 0.38 EUR/kWh plus a time component selected by session start time: 0.60 EUR/hour for starts 20:00-04:00 and 1.20 EUR/hour for starts 04:00-20:00, with no subscription. The tariff is exact, but the current V9 exact-tariff coverage does not yet encode/validate this start-time-dependent component across every DEEZE EVSE.
DEEZE.neededToComplete: Represent the start-time-dependent hourly component exactly in the V9 billing/tariff model and attach the official rule to validated DEEZE EVSEs without flattening it to a kWh-only price.

DECTP.finding: Contipark publishes exact direct-payment electricity prices on official individual car-park pages, but they are not uniform: multiple sites publish 0.55 EUR/kWh while Braunschweig Wallstrasse and Duesseldorf Momentum publish 0.66 EUR/kWh. A DECTP-wide fallback would therefore be false.
DECTP.neededToComplete: Map the 30 audited DECTP sites/684 EVSEs to Contipark facility pages or public direct-payment payloads and attach each exact site price; preserve any site-specific roaming/payment differences.
